# pixelfx

Source: https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx
Commit: a84159688af3ca37a4be05a0d422b94451b2e24e
License: MIT; see LICENSE and NOTICE.md.

Four custom effects were authored and exported with pixelfx's renderer. Runtime Unity uses the exported PNG atlas frames; Node is only needed for authoring. Patch Pixel font is not included. The game UI uses its existing BlackHanSans font.

Authoring checkout: Documents/ChatGPT/디펜스 로그라이크/pixelfx
Export: node tools/render.mjs defense --sheet --no-actor
